headlines.description: Mitchell Trubisky threw a go-ahead, 3-yard touchdown pass to David Montgomery with 2:17 left, lifting the Chicago Bears to a 24-20 win over the slumping Detroit Lions on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trubisky’s 3rd TD pass lifts Bears to 24-20 win over Lions

headlines.description: John Brown became the first Buffalo receiver to throw a touchdown pass immediately after quarterback Josh Allen turned a fourth-down fumble into a first down, and the Bills went on to beat the Dallas Cowboys 26-15 on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trick TD sparks Bills in 26-15 Thanksgiving win over Cowboys

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Taysom Hill blocked a punt to set up his 3-yard touchdown catch, later scored on a 30-yard run and the New Orleans Saints clinched their third straight NFC South title by beating the Atlanta Falcons 26-18 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints beat Falcons to clinch third straight NFC South title

events.name: New York Jets at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: Andy Dalton returned from his three-week exile Sunday and got a long-awaited win for the coach who benched him, throwing a touchdown pass during a 22-6 victory over the New York Jets that ended the longest losing streak in Cincinnati Bengals history.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dalton returns and leads Bengals to 1st win, 22-6 over Jets

headlines.description: Tye Smith returned a blocked field goal 63 yards for the go-ahead touchdown with 5:02 left to play Sunday, helping Tennessee turn the tables at Indianapolis with a 31-17 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blocked field goal helps Titans turn table with win at Indy

headlines.description: DeVante Parker made two acrobatic touchdown receptions and kicker Jason Sanders also had a circus-like scoring catch to help the Miami Dolphins rally past the slumping Philadelphia Eagles 37-31 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bag of tricks helps Dolphins rally past Eagles 37-31

events.name: Green Bay Packers at New York Giants

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw four touchdown passes in the snow and the Green Bay Packers rebounded from a dismal West Coast performance to beat New York 31-13 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers throws 4 TDs, Packers beat skidding Giants 31-13

headlines.description: Derrius Guice ran for 129 yards and two touchdowns and the Washington Redskins made a late goal-line stand to secure a 29-21 victory over the Carolina Panthers on Sunday for their second straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Guise, Redskins hold on to beat Panthers 29-21

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: Nick Foles, Doug Marrone and the Jacksonville Jaguars reached a new low in their first home game in more than a month.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bucs turn Foles’ turnovers into touchdowns, beat Jags 28-11

headlines.description: Neither rain, wind nor the San Francisco 49ers’ top-ranked defense could prevent Lamar Jackson from guiding the Baltimore Ravens to their franchise-record eighth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson, Ravens beat 49ers 20-17 to extend win streak to 8

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: Jared Goff threw for 424 yards and two touchdowns, Robert Woods had 172 yards receiving and the Los Angeles Rams cruised to a 34-7 win over the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Goff throws for 424 yards, Rams roll past Cardinals 34-7

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: Brandon McManus’ 53-yard field goal as time expired, set up by a long interference call, capped a furious final 14 seconds and gave the Broncos a 23-20 victory over the Los Angeles Chargers.
headlines.shortLinkText: McManus’ 53-yard field goal lifts Denver past Chargers 23-20

events.name: Oakland Raiders at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Patrick Mahomes threw for a touchdown and ran for a touchdown, Juan Thornhill returned a pick 46 yards for another score, and the Kansas City Chiefs beat the bumbling Oakland Raiders 40-9 on Sunday to seize control of the AFC West.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs rout Raiders 40-9 to seize AFC West control

events.name: New England Patriots at Houston Texans

headlines.description: Deshaun Watson threw three touchdown passes and had the first TD reception of his career, and the Houston Texans frustrated Tom Brady in a 28-22 victory over the New England Patriots on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Watson throws 3 TDs, catches another; Texans top Pats 28-22

headlines.description: Rashaad Penny scored one touchdown rushing and one receiving, Russell Wilson hit David Moore for a 60-yard TD pass, and the Seattle Seahawks built a big second-half lead before holding off the Minnesota Vikings for a 37-30 win Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks take over 1st place in NFC West, beat Vikings 37-30
